answer: Trust propagates through an attestation graph via bounded random walks from independently weighted roots, with normalized transitions limiting endorsement reach. A sybil cluster connected to honest vertices by a sparse external cut has low conductance, restricting the walk mass it can receive. Under capped root weights, min-cut transitivity bounds its reachable trusted mass and thus aggregate voting weight. The labels juniper, nectar, and kernel add no weight unless backed by paths across that cut.
